200.body: Polish far-right leader Braun to face second trial Nov 5, 2026 | Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! Polish far-right leader Grzegorz Braun will again stand trial, after prosecutors filed an indictment against him for a series of anti-Ukrainian, anti-Jewish, anti-LGBT and anti-EU acts committed during his presidential election campaign last year. The European Parliament has again stripped Polish far-right leader Grzegorz Braun of immunity to face charges of denying Nazi crimes. Additionally, the deputy leader of Braun’s Confederation of the Polish Crown (KKP) party, Roman Fritz, was indicted for assisting in the theft of the EU flag, while four other men (who have not waived their right to anonymity under Polish law) were indicted for their alleged roles in stealing both the EU and Ukrainian flags.

200.title: Visegrad presidents meet EU chief as Poland looks ahead to G20
200.summary: Presidents of the Visegrad Four countries are meeting in Trenčín, Slovakia, on Thursday for talks with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Ukraine, energy and the EU’s future. The two-day summit brings together Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic and Slovakia, a Central European grouping founded in 1991.
200.body: Presidents of the Visegrad Four countries are meeting in Trenčín, Slovakia, on Thursday for talks with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Ukraine, energy and the EU’s future. The two-day summit brings together Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic and Slovakia, a Central European grouping founded in 1991. Slovak President Peter Pellegrini is hosting the gathering, the first V4 presidential summit attended by von der Leyen. For Polish President Karol Nawrocki, the meeting also offers a chance to consult regional counterparts ahead of December's G20 summit in Miami, presidential aide Marcin Przydacz said.

200.body: Shein set to invest €500mn in Polish hub after EU parcel tariffs hit profits By Isaac Hanson 05/11/2026 Singapore-based fast-fashion retailer Shein has announced it will spend €500 million to expand its European logistics hub in Poland after rising EU import duties have cut its profit margins in the bloc. Announcing the investment on LinkedIn Leonard Lin, Shein’s global head of public affairs, said it will significantly expand the operations of its site near Wrocław, Lower Silesia, which the company said would strengthen its European supply chain and allow it to fulfil more EU orders. Falling sales in Europe contributed to Shein’s 67 per cent drop in second quarter profits reported in September. 500.summary: Cognitum One™, Inc. ( cognitum.one ), the sovereign agentic control plane company, today announced MetaLLM™ (metallm) at the 2026 SEMA Show , which runs November 3 through 6 at the Las Vegas Convention Center.
500.body: Cognitum One™, Inc. ( cognitum.one ), the sovereign agentic control plane company, today announced MetaLLM™ (metallm) at the 2026 SEMA Show , which runs November 3 through 6 at the Las Vegas Convention Center. MetaLLM is a model management studio and governance control plane for multi-agent AI deployments on local corporate infrastructure. "Enterprises are paying frontier-model prices for work a small local model can do, and they can't prove which output their own agents actually wrote," said Reuven "rUv" Cohen, Founder and Chief AI Officer of Cognitum One and creator of MetaLLM. MetaLLM gives them a control plane for every model behind it." Open source on GitHub: ruvnet at github.com/ruvnet · ruvLLM at github.com/ruvnet/RuVector/tree/main/crates/ruvllm Professional, licensed enterprise versions from Cognitum One: MetaLLM at cognitum.one/ruvstack/metallm · ruvLLM at cognitum.one/ruvstack/ruvllm What MetaLLM Does Brokers every model call.

500.title: Tripo AI Launches Agentic Canvas, an AI Agent That Builds Reusable 3D Model Workflows for 3D Printing and Games
500.body: Home - Tripo AI Launches Agentic Canvas, an AI Agent That Builds Reusable 3D Model Workflows for 3D Printing and Games 3D Software Tripo AI Launches Agentic Canvas, an AI Agent That Builds Reusable 3D Model Workflows for 3D Printing and Games Aura Moreno 2 minutes ago 0 Tripo AI has released Tripo Agentic Canvas, an AI agent that assembles 3D production steps into node-based workflows users can view, modify, and apply to multiple assets. Agentic Canvas is built around Tripo’s 3D-native foundation models and expands Tripo Studio, the company’s platform for generating and editing single 3D models, by letting users link its tools together. Hi3D moved in a similar direction in September 2026 when it launched Hi3D Agent , which pairs large language model reasoning with the company’s own 3D generation model and brings external tools and reusable Skills into a single conversational workflow.
